subject: Baby Godzilla, pajama storytime and Santa at CityCentre
preheader: Plus: a quiet Thanksgiving week and a plan for the Nov 21 weekend.
intro: This is a gentle stretch before the holiday rush, and the library is carrying it. On Wednesday, Nov 18, Spring Branch Memorial has a Baby Godzilla Party (dinosaur tails for your crawlers), and Thursday, Nov 19 is Tiny Tykes Pajama Story Time for the walkers. Jammies are encouraged.

Heads-up: Thanksgiving week is a school break (Nov 23–27), and I couldn't find a local event for the Nov 21–22 weekend, so a lap around Memorial Park or the Arboretum trails is your best bet. The library's baby and toddler programs aren't listed for Thanksgiving week and come back in December. Then Saturday, Nov 28 brings Santa and the reindeer to the CityCentre plaza.
